title: Priority and reader lifetime have separate responsibilities
takeaway: A join updates retained work scope. Pending selection can observe that update through the same scope object.
assumptions: This is a schematic map of current code. The dashed connection is conditional: no supplied caller shows the work scope being passed to the scheduler. All entities are context.

entities.label: Caller scope
entities.summary: Supplies effective priority through AsyncLocalStorage and parent scopes.

entities.label: Shared GitHub read
entities.summary: Creates shared work and joins it before registering each reader.

entities.label: GitHubWork
entities.summary: Retains the operation promise and mutable scope across awaits.

entities.label: Shared read
entities.summary: Owns reader counts and the shared abort controller.

entities.label: Scheduler
entities.summary: Selects pending tasks by effective priority and controls their admission.

relationships.label: Read under caller scope
relationships.summary: The wrapper joins work under the current caller priority.

relationships.label: Join existing work
relationships.summary: A higher-priority join updates the retained work scope.

relationships.label: Register reader
relationships.summary: After joining work, the wrapper registers a reader with the caller's cancellation signal.

relationships.label: Conditional scope handoff
relationships.summary: The scheduler retains a supplied scope object. The supplied source does not establish this handoff from GitHubWork.

plan.question: How does caller priority reach existing work and affect pending selection?
plan.visualApproach: Keep the caller above the shared GitHub read. Put retained work beside it, reader lifetime below it, and scheduler admission beside the readers.
plan.whyThisForm: The branches separate priority ownership from cancellation. The dashed connection makes the unshown scope handoff visible.
plan.encodings: Solid arrows show established calls. The dashed arrow shows a conditional scope handoff. A divider separates pending selection from active execution. Positions are schematic.
plan.motion: Use a static map. Shared scope identity explains the connection; motion would suggest an enqueue sequence that the supplied source does not establish.
plan.prediction: A pending task given a priority string will not receive later updates to the work scope.
plan.restingState: The scope update, conditional handoff, admission conditions, and separate reader lifetime remain visible.

scenarios.title: An interactive caller joins existing work
scenarios.input: An interactive caller reads an existing shared GitHub operation.

frames.title: Retained scope connects promotion to selection
frames.caption: The join updates scope. A later drain can observe that update if the scheduler retains the same scope. Completion releases capacity and calls drain; the join does not.
